source: S1 (missions and points) + S4 (run procedure) + S6 (overrides)
note: Rules only. This file does NOT implement a scorer - that is Phase 6. Every mission references a canonical ID frozen in CLAUDE.md 5.3 (ADR-012) and cites the rule it comes from; quotes are in docs/citations.json.

damaged.scope: GLOBAL - evaluated ABOVE every mission block, not inside the bonus block
damaged.note: A correctly-placed but damaged note scores 0, not 20. S1's scoring sheet never states this; it comes from the general rules. Deliberate damage can also disqualify the round, and 7.7 covers objects that score nothing.

completely_in.definition: the object touches the corresponding area and no other area on the mat
completely_in.implementation: contains(target.polygon_visible_mm, object.footprint) AND for every area a where a.scoring and a.id != target.id: not intersects(a.polygon_visible_mm, object.footprint)
completely_in.ambiguity_note: The domain is a FORCED reading, not a conservative choice: every scoring target except backstage is drawn on top of a larger fill, so a literal reading of 'no other area on the mat' would make the game unscoreable.

upright.primary_test: the object's base is fully in contact with the mat
upright.definition_note: The S6 answer defines NOT upright as 'not fully touching the floor' - a CONTACT predicate, not an angular one.

upright_tolerance_deg.note: Retained as a parameter, but the contact test is what has official backing. Any result depending on the angle must be reported as a sweep (AS-6). Field test P5 replaces this with a measurement.

moved.written_definition: no longer touches its initial position AND is no longer upright
moved.ambiguity_note: The same S1 page awards 0 to a clef that is no longer upright while still in its initial position, which only follows if the conditions are OR-ed. OPEN, routed to S6.

moved_semantics.note: OR is the stricter reading, so plans built on it do not over-promise.

reference_pose.source: run-time state, NEVER a spec constant
reference_pose.rule: S4 10.8 scores the end-of-attempt field state; 9.6 has judges re-set tables between rounds
reference_pose.note: moved() compares against THAT RUN's initial pose (ADR-014). field_spec.json carries only nominal_start_pose_mm + placement_tolerance_mm.

held_by_mechanism.effect: scores at the PARTIAL tier, not zero
held_by_mechanism.ambiguity_note: RESOLVED, and the old conservative default of 0 was WRONG - it understated achievable score by 10 points per held object.
held_by_mechanism.strategy_consequence: The abort policy INVERTS: when the clock runs out mid-placement, leave the object in the target area rather than retreating with it. Half credit beats nothing.

robot_overlap.effect: the robot is not 'an area on the mat'; its presence does not break completely_in
robot_overlap.evidence_class: IMPLICATION, not an explicit statement - the judge scored a microphone as 'completely inside' while the gripper was still holding it, deducting only for uprightness.

missions.title: Connect the amplifier with the speakers

partial.condition: only partly in the grey area OR not upright

missions.constraint: only ONE cable per area scores points (S1 p8)
missions.note: Partial credit here is 5/15 = 33.3 %, NOT the 50 % that applies to the microphone and notes. A sloppy cable placement is worth 5; a sloppy note 10.

partial.condition: only partly in the microphone target area OR not upright

missions.title: Prepare the show - instruments
missions.note: No uprightness requirement and no partial credit. backstage EXCLUDES the grey border, so its polygon is the inset [0,0,393.809,317.219], not the pink fill (ADR-015 inset_by). All three instruments may score in the same area - unlike the cables, which are one per area.

missions.title: Play the song
missions.pairing: each note scores only in its CORRESPONDING-COLOURED target; wrong colour scores 0

partial.condition: only partly in the corresponding target OR not upright

missions.full_condition: completely_in(note, matching target INCLUDING its grey border) AND upright
missions.note: The target area INCLUDES the grey border (S1 p11), so the scoring polygon is the 79.7 mm outer square, not the 47.8 mm coloured centre. This mission is 120/255 = 47 % of the total.

missions.title: Bonus points

floor_not_prize.statement: bonus points can be awarded even if the robot never leaves the start area, provided the bonus objects are not moved or damaged
floor_not_prize.consequence: A run that starts and immediately stops scores 40/255. Bonus points cannot be EARNED, only LOST.
floor_not_prize.note: Every mission's EV must be written this way, never as a gross point gain. The 40 is an explicit term in every row of any strategy decision table.

missions.note: speaker_a and speaker_b are distinct IDs precisely because bonus scores 10 EACH to a max of 20 - a singular `speaker` could not express which one toppled.

time.return_to_start_rule: S4 10.7 lists every way an attempt ends; no return requirement appears

forced_120s.condition: the team finishes without having solved a (partial) task that yields positive points
forced_120s.ambiguity_note: OPEN: does a bonus-only run count as 'solving a task'? Bonus points are positive and on the season-challenge sheet, but passively not damaging an object is arguably not solving anything. Default: forced to 120 s.

forced_120s.condition: the robot loses a controller, motor or sensor
forced_120s.note: Other shed parts are free and stay on the field. This makes part_detachment a DESIGN constraint, not a simulator detail - and 5.1's post-start size freedom actively encourages deployable mechanisms.

ranking.note: Time is a pure tie-break, so it ranks below E[score] and below Var[score] in any objective function.
ranking.ambiguity_status: RESOLVED - the conservative default was correct

randomization.scored_against: the randomization at the beginning of the run (S4 10.8)

runtime_only.statement: randomization happens AFTER the robots are in quarantine, entering data by adjusting the position or orientation of robot parts is prohibited, and no team action is permitted after randomization
runtime_only.consequence: The 24 permutations can only be resolved by RUNTIME SENSING. This is the premise of every mission program.

partial_credit_is_not_uniform.explanation: Anti-pattern #7 previously asserted a uniform 50 %. Any EV comparison between 'many rough placements' and 'few precise ones' that assumed uniformity is invalid.
